title: "Mathematical method and numerical contract"
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
vignette: >
  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Mathematical method and numerical contract}
  %\VignetteEngine{knitr::rmarkdown}
  %\VignetteEncoding{UTF-8}
---

`grsem` minimizes

\[
F_{SEM}(\theta)+\lambda\{(1-\alpha)\sum_g w_g\|\theta_g\|_2+
\alpha\sum_jv_j|\theta_j|\}.
\]

The plus sign is essential for a minimization problem. Coordinates with zero
penalty factor are updated by the smooth SEM gradient but bypass the proximal
shrinkage. Non-overlapping sparse-group updates first apply coordinate soft
thresholding and then group soft thresholding. Backtracking verifies the
standard smooth-part majorization inequality. The reported diagnostic is the
maximum proximal-gradient mapping, not merely an optimizer status flag.

The SEM likelihood is non-convex. The solver therefore targets a local
stationary point and uses warm starts plus deterministic alternative starts;
it does not claim global optimality. Version 0.1 supports continuous data,
one group, complete observations and ML. Penalized estimates, post-selection
refits, and held-out evaluation are separate objects and inferential stages.
